correctness.rationale: The stationary two-sided renewal property makes backward age exponential and independent of new heading and pre-renewal position; a=e^(-mu B) is Beta(alpha,1), yielding Jacobian a^-3 in g_alpha(x|n). Projecting N·Y onto the uniform[-1,1] coordinate direction yields exact sign condition a>1/(1+u). Rare-tumbling weak convergence gives the log2-1/2 coefficient. A gamma random measure whose normalized mass is independent of total gives the Gaussian local density through an explicit integrable characteristic-function bound; the 1/alpha boundary layer yields sqrt(3/(2pi)). Independent density normalization, unit-alpha variance and Q quadrature, and three-rate renewal Monte Carlo agree; Monte Carlo is not a proof of tails.
